answer: Like underground mycelium weaving mineral soil, agents fuse consensus through web-of-trust staking. Each node must drop an anchor into long-term collateral, turning raw computation into a durable marble of peer-validated identity. Network influence expands only when a positive reputation delta accumulates across non-colluding topological clusters. Because coordinated validation across disparate clusters scales at an exponential attacker cost O(2^k), generating hollow Sybil swarms yields zero cryptographic leverage and rapidly collapses.
